dont_panic: Your 2001 Volvo S60 is showing code P0606. This code means the engine control module (ECM) or powertrain control module (PCM) processor might not be working correctly. The vehicle’s engine is running at 720 RPM with no movement, coolant is at 195°F (normal operating temperature), and engine load is 22%. These measurements don’t show immediate danger. The code’s exact meaning isn’t fully verified yet, so it’s unclear if it’s a serious issue.
